title: El Agave de Amatitán, VISTA STORIES
comment: agave-amatitan (VISTA): campos de agave azul y jimadores en Amatitán, Jalisco. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.TOBIAS_CORONA: Mexican man from Jalisco, old agave harvester, 66 years old, lean and strong, dark-brown weathered skin, short grey hair, a thick white mustache, a white long-sleeve cotton work shirt, dark work trousers, worn leather boots, his hands empty.
chars.LUPE_CORONA: Mexican woman from Jalisco, agave harvester, 30 years old, brown skin, a long black braid, a light-pink long-sleeve work shirt with rolled sleeves, jeans, work boots, her hands empty.
chars.MARIELA_ZEPEDA: Mexican businesswoman, 36 years old, light skin, black hair in a sleek high ponytail, red lipstick, a white blazer over a black top, black trousers, white sneakers, sunglasses on her head, holding a clipboard.
chars.LEANDRO_ESCALANTE: Elegant Mexican tequila house owner, 72 years old, light skin, silver hair, a neat silver goatee, a cream panama hat, a navy-blue linen suit with a white shirt open at the collar, brown loafers, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_AGAVEAMATITAN: Blue agave field in Amatitán, Jalisco, in the late afternoon: endless rows of spiky blue agave plants on red earth, a pile of harvested agave hearts beside a dirt road, an old wooden cart, green hills behind, warm golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
